verdict.rationale: Proa is a server-rendered Rust web framework, so authoring standards-based web components is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only typed Rust components, Shadcn-style vendored UI components, and hydrated islands that emit vanilla-JS modules. Nothing in the pack shows authoring Web Components or Custom Elements (customElements.define, shadow DOM, etc.), and proprietary component models do not count toward this story.
